reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents a branded opportunity involving money deposited into a trading pool in connection with an approximately tenfold return claim. It also promotes team-based investment and recurring bonuses as a route to weekly earnings, with instructions to contact the sender through Telegram for follow-up.

citations.quote: but why be normal use the MT is system to your advantage and build a business gather a team of people and earn the binary bonus
For more information, please contact the person who sent you this video.
You need to have at least $200 in your own Trading Pool account. Then introduce someone in the right hand side and left hand side of the business.

Your team leader and other members above you will be adding people into one leg which is known as the power leg. You and people you have joined will add people into the other leg which is known as the profit leg.
Once you are binary qualified, you will receive a binary bonus every Saturday from whichever of these legs is the smallest in terms of money invested.

opening.argument: The presentation uses qualified, approximate language rather than promising a guaranteed outcome. It says a participant will need to put in “roughly 10 times” the desired monthly amount, and describes bonuses as something that can be earned if a team is built, not as an automatic entitlement. It also expressly states that recruitment is not necessary because earnings may come from daily trading activities. Those qualifications leave room for uncertainty and individual results; the material does not state that every viewer will profit, that losses are impossible, or that the stated amount is guaranteed.

citations.quote: you will need to put in roughly 10 times what you expect to get monthly
It is not necessary to recruit people into mirror trading international as you learn from the daily trading activities.
you will earn good bonuses weekly if you build a team

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference emphasizes the tenfold figure and the team structure, but it treats an approximate illustration as a guaranteed return and treats the bonus explanation as proof of deception. The presentation itself distinguishes ordinary participation from optional team-building and does not say that a viewer must recruit anyone or that a particular profit is certain. Contact information alone does not establish that the underlying opportunity is fraudulent.

citations.quote: you will need to put in roughly 10 times what you expect to get monthly
It is not necessary to recruit people into mirror trading international

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Approximate wording does not make the claim a neutral risk warning: the video still connects the amount deposited with what the viewer expects to receive monthly. More importantly, it explicitly promotes weekly bonuses tied to team construction and money invested, while the statement that recruitment is unnecessary is immediately contrasted with earning “good bonuses weekly” by building a team. The absence of a literal guarantee does not remove the solicitation or its income claim.

citations.quote: you will need to put in roughly 10 times what you expect to get monthly
But as you can see, you will earn good bonuses weekly if you build a team
from whichever of these legs is the smallest in terms of money invested

opening.argument: The material is structured as an explanatory tutorial about how the MTI binary system operates. It asks how binary bonuses are earned, then explains the two sides, the roles of a team leader and members, and how the smaller side is used for calculating a bonus. The visual presentation likewise labels the concepts “Team Leader,” “New Referrals,” and “Power Leg,” supporting an instructional reading. Explaining a system's mechanics is not the same as independently certifying that the system is safe or guaranteeing that viewers will make money.

citations.quote: how can you earn binary bonuses from Meritrading International?
Every member of MTI has two legs
Once you are binary qualified, you will receive a binary bonus every Saturday

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference reads instructional explanations as an endorsement, but the content's central activity is explaining procedures: the two legs, who adds members, and how the smaller side is measured. The title and description also identify the subject as MTI basics and how the binary works. A tutorial can describe a controversial or risky business model without being a disguised promise that the model is legitimate.

citations.quote: Mirror Trading International Basics - The Binary
Understanding the basics, how the MTI Binary Works
Your team leader and other members above you will be adding people into one leg

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The explanation is not detached analysis. It tells viewers what to deposit, whom to introduce, how to build the two legs, and what recurring payment to expect. Calling the material “basics” does not change that its instructional steps facilitate participation. The diagrams reinforce referrals and a power leg, while the narration expressly links team-building to weekly bonuses; this is operational promotion, not merely neutral education.

citations.quote: You need to have at least $200 in your own Trading Pool account.
Then introduce someone in the right hand side and left hand side of the business.
you will earn good bonuses weekly if you build a team

opening.argument: The described benefit can be framed as a participation-based referral bonus associated with a trading service, rather than proof of a scam. The video explains that bonuses depend on the smaller side's invested amount and separately says that people can earn from daily trading activities without recruiting. It does not display a credential request, ask viewers to send money to the presenter, identify a guaranteed return, or show an actual payment or victim outcome. The supplied material therefore establishes a promotional compensation structure, but not every element needed to conclude that the opportunity is fraudulent.

citations.quote: It is not necessary to recruit people into mirror trading international as you learn from the daily trading activities.
you will receive a binary bonus every Saturday from whichever of these legs is the smallest in terms of money invested.
For more information, please contact the person who sent you this video.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference identifies deposits, team-building, and recurring bonuses, but those facts can also describe a referral or loyalty-style compensation program. It does not show that the speaker personally takes deposits, that anyone was harmed, or that the weekly payment is guaranteed. The contact instruction is an ordinary invitation to obtain more information and does not itself establish fraudulent conduct.

citations.quote: For more information, please contact the person who sent you this video.
It is not necessary to recruit people into mirror trading international

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is not an ordinary discount or loyalty reward. Qualification requires at least $200 in the viewer's own trading-pool account, and the payment is calculated from money invested across two recruited legs. The instruction to introduce someone on both sides and the promise of weekly bonuses if a team is built show that recruitment and participant investment are the operating mechanism, even though no credential request or victim story appears.
